testEnvironment: Node + markdown-it + jsdom, real CodeMirror state/view, synthetic events and DOM mutations; geometry supplied to sizing tests; Obsidian APIs mocked; editor tests use mocked or captured MathJax CHTML, plus an optional actual local MathJax compatibility test
localCompatibilityScope: Fourteen DOM-input/touch/source-navigation tests additionally use an isolated core extracted from the locally installed Obsidian 1.14.4 APK, including a minimal Markdown escape-hiding fixture; this is not an Android UI or keyboard test
localMathJaxScope: Optional tests run 20 original expressions through the installed MathJax 4.1.3, verify annotations and actual error output, and check source navigation in the private 33-formula note when available; no layout or UI testing
scope: Development checks with optional local fixtures. Those notes and extracted host bundles are not distributed. See release verification.json for clean-checkout results.
